calculators.name: Heat Treatment - Priced by Weight
calculators.description: A heat-treatment service priced by weight: Unit Weight Cost x batch weight, or the Min Batch Cost below the Min Batch Weight, times the case-depth multiplier (1 when the process has none), per part. Cycle Time is the handling time for the weight of the part (tblHandlingTimes).
operations: Vacuum Air Harden with High Temper

fields.name: Batch Service Cost
fields.formula: IF({Batch Weight} < {Min Batch Weight}, {Min Batch Cost}, {Batch Weight} * {Unit Weight Cost}) * {Case Depth Multiplier}

calculators.name: Heat Treatment - Certification
calculators.description: Certification is charged once per batch: Certification Cost / Batch Size per part. It takes no machine time.

calculators.name: Heat Treatment - Straighten
calculators.description: Straightening runs at the parts-per-hour rate of the weight class of the part (small, medium or large): Cycle Time = 3600 / Straightening Rate.

calculators.name: Heat Treatment - Age
calculators.description: Aging runs in oven loads: Oven Loads = ceil(Batch Size / Parts per Oven Load); Cycle Time per part = Oven Loads x Aging Time x 3600 / Batch Size.

calculators.name: Heat Treatment - Hot Isostatic Pressing
calculators.description: One HIP load = heat-up + hold + cool-down + pressurize + vacuum purge; Loads = ceil(Batch Size / Parts per Load); Cycle Time per part = Loads x Load Time x 60 / Batch Size.

fields.name: Load Time
fields.formula: ({Hold Temperature} - {Room Temperature}) / {Heating Rate} + {Hold Time} * 60 + ({Hold Temperature} - {Room Temperature}) / {Cooling Rate} + {Pressurize Time} + {Vacuum Purge Time}
